about_the_game:
Attention! This demo version was developed and shared to provide players with only basic gameplay mechanics and to convey the vision of the full version of the game.

All mechanics and items that are disabled for the demo version are planned to be included in the game in the early access version. If you have any additional suggestions, mechanics and items that you would like us to include in our game, or any negative situations you encounter in the game, do not forget to use the comments section or contact us through the necessary channels. Thank you for taking the time to play our game.

Included features for demo:

  • Pick and place Item system

  • Buy Item menu

  • Germination mechanics

  • Lettuce seed

  • Selling Item mechanics

  • Soilless growing items and mechanics

Disableed features for demo:

  • Save and Load game option

  • Employing workers

  • Pests that damage plants

  • Buying new greenhouses

  • All seeds except lettuce mentioned in the trailer

Hydroponic Farming: From Seed to Success!

Take control of your own hydroponic farm and turn a simple seed into a thriving business! Begin your journey by purchasing a variety of seeds from the market, selecting the best options to suit your setup. Carefully germinate your seeds using the proper equipment, ensuring they develop into healthy seedlings ready for the next stage.

Once your plants are strong enough, transfer them to your hydroponic system, where they will grow without soil, relying on nutrient-rich water. Choose from different hydroponic techniques to maximize efficiency and productivity. Manage water flow, nutrient balance, and environmental conditions to create the perfect growing environment. Experiment with different plant species, each with unique growth rates and market values.

As your crops flourish, harvest them at peak freshness and prepare them for sale. Expand your operation by reinvesting profits into new equipment, larger facilities, and advanced technologies to enhance efficiency. Unlock better tools, automate processes, and diversify your farm to increase output and profits.

Grow your business from a small greenhouse to a large-scale hydroponic empire! Improve your workflow, optimize your setup, and expand your reach in the agricultural market. Whether you’re a beginner learning the fundamentals or an expert fine-tuning your strategies, this simulator provides an immersive and rewarding experience in modern farming.

Are you ready to build the future of sustainable agriculture? Start your hydroponic farming journey today!

name: HYDROPLANT Tycoon Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050 / AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: i5 7600K RYZEN 5 2600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 / AMD RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Start with tiny sprouts and nurture them into thriving crops using advanced hydroponics! Design your own farming system, experiment with different plants, customize your setup, and meet market demands to grow your business. Discover the perfect harmony of nature and technology!
